user.title: Set up Cast Notifier
user.description: Cast Notifier speaks messages on one Google Cast player through tts.speak. Pick the player and the text-to-speech engine to use here; everything else can be changed later from the integration's options.

data_description.media_player: The Cast (or other) media_player entity that will speak.
data_description.tts_entity: The tts.* entity used to generate speech, e.g. tts.home_assistant_cloud.
data_description.language: Optional language code passed to tts.speak, e.g. en-US. Leave empty to use the engine's default.
data_description.voice: Optional voice name, or a JSON object of tts.speak options, e.g. {"voice": "fr-FR-Standard-A"}.
data_description.volume: If set, the player's volume is set to this level before speaking and restored afterwards.
data_description.restore_volume: Restore the volume the player had before speaking, once the message is done.
data_description.announce_prefix: Optional text spoken before every message, e.g. "Attention."
data_description.deny_domains: Comma-separated entity domains. A call whose data.source_entity belongs to one of them is refused and logged instead of spoken.

abort.already_configured: This player is already configured for Cast Notifier.
